_comment: The fixed query+tools set every hop is validated against: JAX/HF reference -> numpy reference -> CQ4-dequant host -> board. Same inputs, same expected tool call, at every stage. Do not edit casually - changing a case invalidates every recorded baseline. Add new cases at the end.

_schema.id: stable short name, used in filenames
_schema.query: the user utterance fed to the encoder
_schema.tools: the tool definitions JSON string, exactly as passed to generate()
_schema.expect: the tool call we believe is correct; NOT authoritative until the host reference confirms it
_schema.why: what this case is here to catch

cases.query: What's the weather in San Francisco?
cases.why: The README's own example. If this breaks, the port is broken - it is the canary, not a test.
Empty argument object. Exercises the shortest possible decode and the constrained-decoder's empty-object path.

cases.tools: [{"name":"get_weather","description":"Get current weather for a city.","parameters":{"location":{"type":"string","description":"City name.","required":true}}},{"name":"set_light","description":"Turn a light on or off.","parameters":{"room":{"type":"string","description":"Room name.","required":true},"on":{"type":"boolean","description":"Desired state.","required":true}}}]
cases.why: Tool SELECTION, not just extraction, plus a boolean argument. Quantization damage shows up in selection before it shows up in copying a string.
Digit tokens are rare and their embeddings quantize badly. A number that comes back as 6 or 688 is the classic 4-bit failure.

cases.query: Play some jazz in the living room at half volume.
cases.tools: [{"name":"get_weather","description":"Get current weather for a city.","parameters":{"location":{"type":"string","description":"City name.","required":true}}},{"name":"set_light","description":"Turn a light on or off.","parameters":{"room":{"type":"string","description":"Room name.","required":true},"on":{"type":"boolean","description":"Desired state.","required":true}}},{"name":"set_thermostat","description":"Set the target temperature.","parameters":{"temperature":{"type":"number","description":"Target temperature in Fahrenheit.","required":true}}},{"name":"send_message","description":"Send a text message to a contact.","parameters":{"recipient":{"type":"string","description":"Contact name.","required":true},"body":{"type":"string","description":"Message text.","required":true}}},{"name":"play_music","description":"Play music in a room.","parameters":{"genre":{"type":"string","description":"Music genre.","required":true},"room":{"type":"string","description":"Room name.","required":true},"volume":{"type":"number","description":"Volume from 0 to 100.","required":false}}},{"name":"set_timer","description":"Start a countdown timer.","parameters":{"minutes":{"type":"number","description":"Duration in minutes.","required":true}}}]
cases.why: Six tools is a realistic encoder prefill length and drives the worst-case encoder cost. Also an OPTIONAL argument and an inferred value ('half' -> 50).

cases.query: Write me a poem about the sea.
cases.why: Negative case. Whatever the reference does here - refuse, emit nothing, or hallucinate get_weather - the BOARD must do the same thing. expect:null means 'match the host reference', not 'must be empty'.

cases.query: Is the UPS still on mains power?
cases.tools: [{"name":"get_ups_status","description":"Read the current UPS state.","parameters":{"field":{"type":"string","description":"Which field to read: mains, ac_draw, battery, runtime.","required":true}}}]
cases.why: The actual product. This board already serves UPS telemetry over Ethernet; this is the query that has to work for Needle-on-P4 to be worth anything.

cases.query: Text Jose: "running late — be there in 10"
cases.tools: [{"name":"send_message","description":"Send a text message to a contact.","parameters":{"recipient":{"type":"string","description":"Contact name.","required":true},"body":{"type":"string","description":"Message text.","required":true}}}]
cases.why: Tokenizer torture: an em dash, nested quotes, and a digit. This case exists to catch a C tokenizer port that diverges from SentencePiece on byte_fallback. Compare TOKEN IDS here, not just the final JSON.
